rationale_summary: This mandates catalog reflects a close three-way balance led by innovation_enablement, which runs across every cited statute and executive action via technical standards, testbeds, research infrastructure (NAIRR), open-source/open-weight encouragement, AI adoption, and reviewing regulatory obstacles from rescinded EO 14110. Innovation_enablement narrowly edges out national_security and economic_competitiveness, which are strongly articulated in the 2025 executive actions through military/intelligence data centers, critical infrastructure cybersecurity, biosecurity, frontier national security risk evaluations, and sustaining America's global AI dominance. Fundamental_rights (free speech, testing for bias in training data) and consumer_public_safety (safe and trustworthy AI) appear as smaller supporting rationales.

evidence_spans.quote: encourage open-source and open-weight AI; enable AI adoption; invest in AI-enabled science; invest in AI interpretability, control, and robustness breakthroughs; build an AI evaluations ecosystem;
evidence_spans.source_section: Winning the Race: America’s AI Action Plan (7/23/2025)

evidence_spans.quote: support the development of technical standards and guidelines that promote safe and trustworthy AI systems;

build high-security data centers for military and intelligence community usage; bolster critical infrastructure cybersecurity; promote secure-by-design AI technologies and applications; promote mature federal capacity for AI incident response; invest in biosecurity; and ensure that the U.S. government is at the forefront of evaluating national security risks in frontier models.
evidence_spans.source_section: Winning the Race: America’s AI Action Plan (7/23/2025)

evidence_spans.quote: Calls for an action plan to sustain and enhance America’s global AI dominance in order to promote human flourishing, economic competitiveness, and national security.
evidence_spans.source_section: Removing Barriers to American Leadership in Artificial Intelligence (1/23/2025)
